description: This file defines the HiringManagerAPI class, which serves as a REST API endpoint for retrieving a list of hiring managers (employees accessible for recruitment management) in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a generic Endpoint class and implements CollectionEndpoint to handle collection-based API responses. The class makes use of various traits and services for fetching vacancy and employee data, filtering by access permissions, and supports API documentation annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI.

classes.name: HiringManagerAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for retrieving a list of hiring managers (employees relevant for recruitment processes) within the OrangeHRM system. It handles GET requests to list employees based on vacancy access permissions, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles the retrieval of a paginated and optionally sorted list of hiring managers (employees) accessible to the current user, based on vacancy permissions. Returns an EndpointCollectionResult with employee data and total count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' method, primarily sorting and pagination parameters.
